qa.overall_assessment: Implementation is correct and functional. All success criteria pass. One minor issue found: generate-and-deploy.sh hardcodes the domain 'travel.life-ai.app' instead of using LOCAL_DEPLOY_DOMAIN env var. This does not block release but should be fixed for consistency.

success_criteria_results.verification_method: systemctl status, ss -tlnp, curl localhost:8094, compared service file to knowledge-web.service pattern
success_criteria_results.details: Service is active (running), enabled, listening on port 8094. Service file follows exact same pattern as knowledge-web.service (python3 -m http.server). curl returns HTTP 200 with valid HTML.
evidence: Service file matches knowledge-web.service pattern exactly (only port and directory differ)

success_criteria_results.criterion: deploy-travel-plans.sh copies HTML to /var/www/travel/{destination-slug}/{date}/index.html AND generates local index.html
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Code review of Step 8.5 (lines 523-630), manual test creating /var/www/travel/test-destination/2026-03-20/index.html and verifying it serves via localhost:8094
success_criteria_results.details: Step 8.5 correctly creates LOCAL_TARGET_DIR, copies INPUT_FILE, then scans LOCAL_DEPLOY_DIR (not DEPLOY_DIR temp dir) to regenerate index.html. Manual test confirmed files are served correctly. Graceful fallback exists when LOCAL_DEPLOY_DIR doesn't exist (line 627-630).
evidence: Line 527: if [ -d LOCAL_DEPLOY_DIR ] provides graceful fallback
Manual test: created test file, curl returned content with exit 0

success_criteria_results.criterion: generate-and-deploy.sh shows both GitHub Pages URL and local travel.life-ai.app URL
success_criteria_results.details: Step [5/5] added at lines 147-148 showing local URL. deploy-travel-plans.sh final output (lines 640-657) shows both GitHub Pages and Local (Cloudflare) URLs for plan and index pages.
evidence: deploy-travel-plans.sh lines 646-651: shows GitHub Pages URL and Local (Cloudflare) URL

success_criteria_results.criterion: Running /plan or /review triggers both deployments automatically
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Code flow analysis: /plan and /review call generate-and-deploy.sh which calls deploy-travel-plans.sh
success_criteria_results.details: generate-and-deploy.sh calls deploy-travel-plans.sh (line 144) which now includes Step 8.5 for local deployment. No changes needed to /plan or /review commands as they already call generate-and-deploy.sh.
evidence: deploy-travel-plans.sh Step 8.5 runs as part of the same script flow

success_criteria_results.verification_method: MD5 checksum comparison of pre-Step-8.5 code between old and new versions
success_criteria_results.details: Lines 1-10 (before new vars) match exactly (MD5: 5148f05abe8b93e571029a2bde2f9c38). Lines 11-520 (old) match lines 13-522 (new, offset by 2 for new config vars) exactly (MD5: e10db8f5d8ec8e62c4678791a5234432). Only the final output message was reformatted to show both URLs.
evidence: Old lines 1-10 MD5 == New lines 1-10 MD5: 5148f05abe8b93e571029a2bde2f9c38
Old lines 11-520 MD5 == New lines 13-522 MD5: e10db8f5d8ec8e62c4678791a5234432
Git diff confirms only additions: lines 11-12 (config vars), lines 523-630 (Step 8.5), lines 643-657 (reformatted output)

root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause was that deploy-travel-plans.sh only supported GitHub Pages deployment. The fix adds parallel local deployment to /var/www/travel/ via Step 8.5, served by travel-web.service on port 8094. The local deployment is additive and does not interfere with GitHub Pages.

issues.finding: Hardcoded domain 'travel.life-ai.app' at line 148 instead of using LOCAL_DEPLOY_DOMAIN env var
issues.recommendation: Use LOCAL_DEPLOY_DOMAIN=${LOCAL_DEPLOY_DOMAIN:-travel.life-ai.app} at the top and reference it in the echo statement for consistency with deploy-travel-plans.sh
